description: This Java interface defines a builder pattern for creating responses and events related to modifying attributes in a live signaling context within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes nested factory interfaces for producing command responses and event instances specific to attribute creation and modification actions.

classes.name: ModifyAttributeLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: An interface for building responses and events for modify attribute commands within a live signaling context.

classes.name: ModifyAttributeLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.ResponseFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for generating command responses such as created, modified, or error responses related to attribute modification.

classes.name: ModifyAttributeLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.EventFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for producing event instances like AttributeCreated and AttributeModified triggered by attribute modification commands.

methods.name: created
methods.description: Creates a response indicating an attribute has been created.

methods.name: modified
methods.description: Creates a response indicating an attribute has been modified.

methods.name: attributeNotAccessibleError
methods.description: Creates an error response indicating the attribute was not accessible.

methods.name: attributeNotModifiableError
methods.description: Creates an error response indicating the attribute was not modifiable.

methods.name: created
methods.description: Creates an AttributeCreated event based on the command.

methods.name: modified
methods.description: Creates an AttributeModified event based on the command.
